text: Hello, boys and girls.I'm Helen.Welcome to my English class.Please prepare your notebook and your stationery.Today, we are going to have the assessment period 3, writing about my friend and my family.And you are going to make some assessments by yourself with the help of this table.First, let's review the sounds.Please read the sounds and the words by yourself.Good.Now, let's listen, choose, and write down the missing letters.Please take out your notebook and stationery.Listen, choose, and write on your notebook.Are you ready?Let's go.Drain brain.Wasp wash.Mask mask.Now, let's check the answers.Please follow me.Wasp wasp.Wash wash.Quite good.Please finish assessment 1 by yourself.One star or two stars.We talked about our friends and families during project 1 and 2.In this class, we are going to learn how to write a passage.First, we are going to write about my friend.Then, finish assessment 2 by yourself.Generally speaking, a passage consists of three parts.The beginning part, the body part, and the ending part.Look, this is my student's homework of project 1.He has written about his new friend.As you can see in your book is the example of the beginning part.I have a new friend.It is the topic sentence.At the body part, my student has written some information about his new friend Tom.Please read by yourself.Right.After reading, we know the name, the age, the appearance, and the abilities of my student's new friend.If you want to make your passage better, you may write more information about your friend.For example, your friend's hobbies, favorites, and so on.Also, you can use different sentence patterns to describe your friend.Please read these sentence patterns by yourself.At the ending part, we usually write a concluding sentence.But, there is no ending in this passage.So, I suggest he'd better write I like my new friend at the end of this passage.Now, try to write a passage about your friend by yourself.Please pay attention the three parts of the passage.The information of your friend and sentence patterns.Think and write on your notebook.At the ending part, you should write I like my friend at the end of this passage.現在我的學生托里斯已經完成了他的文章,請自己讀讀你覺得這個詞語如何?我覺得好在開始部分,托里斯告訴我們他有個朋友,她的名字是甚麼在身體部分,我們更了解他的朋友琳達,他使用了不同的詞語非常好在結尾部分,托里斯告訴我們他們是好朋友可能是因為他們一起做了一些事情,所以他們有相同的興趣你的呢?完成二個分析吧一星或兩星?不錯現在讓我們享受另一個詞語,我的朋友,請聽聽我們是好朋友,我們一起玩樂真是個好詞語如果你想寫一個詞語的話,我會給你一些建議在開始部分和結尾部分,你可以寫題目的詞語和結尾的詞語在身體部分,你可以寫題目的詞語和結尾的詞語非常好,請自己讀非常好,現在讓我們進入題目,我的家人我會給你們一些建議在開始部分,請自己寫題目的詞語和結尾的詞語和結尾的詞語在身體部分,請自己寫題目的詞語和結尾的詞語和結尾的詞語在身體部分,你可以寫題目的詞語和結尾的詞語和結尾的詞語和結尾的詞語和結尾的詞語和結尾的詞語和結尾的詞語在身體部分,請自己麵包的篩選First of all, think about these questions, beginning with what.Can you ask any questions?Think it over.My student Toris has some questions.What is his or her name?What does he or she look like?What does he or she do?What can he or she do?What does he or she like doing?What's his or her favorite food?These questions are about name, appearance, job, abilities, hobbies, and favorites.Then you can use different sentence patterns to describe your family members.At last, write something about yourself by using these sentence patterns.Wow, a nice family.At the ending part, you can write some concluding sentences.What do you think of your family?What do you do with your family?Now, please think about your family with the help of the patterns.Then write my family in your notebook.I don't know what kind of family you are.Time's up, you can finish it after class.From period 1 to period 3, we have finished the assessments about sounds, vocabulary, grammar, passage, and topics.They focus on listening, speaking, reading, and writing.You really did a good job, boys and girls.The assignment for today, think and write about your family, then finish assessment 3 by yourself.So much for today.Goodbye, boys and girls.
